scope: Build an opt-in original Go library/CLI to summarize Codex exec JSONL and independently check authored public coding task behavior. Preserve existing interactive Codex wrapper defaults. No new paid model runs in this implementation cycle; fake fixtures remain explicitly authored telemetry fixtures, never model outcomes.
official_schema: https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/non-interactive-mode; fetched2026-10-01. Events thread.started,turn.started,turn.completed,turn.failed,item.*,error. turn.completed usage input_tokens,cached_input_tokens,output_tokens with optional reasoning_output_tokens in current example. CLI-installed version0.158.0 must be captured by a future executor, not hardcoded as proof of execution.
record: Separate requested model/reasoning, router proposal/applied request, observed provider/model evidence, process exit, turn terminal status and independent acceptance. No actual model identity may be inferred from requested flags or difficulty labels. Completion of a turn or command is not completed task acceptance. Missing usage/model/time/provenance is unknown, not zero.
usage: Sum observed completed-turn usage across all attempts/retries; cached input is a subset of input, and reasoning output is separately reported when observed, never added twice. Preserve unknown total if any turn/attempt lacks usage or terminates incomplete/failed. Record partial observed totals, counts, terminal failures/errors and integrity status; do not convert tokens to subscription allowance or fees.
privacy: Parse bounded JSONL privately, discard thread/item IDs, message/reasoning/tool/command/file bodies and local paths from summary. Errors use fixed codes without echoing untrusted lines. Only authored public fixture metadata and aggregate numeric/enum reports are publishable by this command. Stream hashes bind local trace bytes but do not publish raw trace. No hidden automatic model launch/upload.
bounds: Default whole trace limit64MiB, line/event limit1MiB, event limit100000 and turn limit4096. Reject malformed/truncated/duplicate relevant control fields, non-integer/negative/overflow usage, invalid lifecycle and limits without outputting a successful record. Unknown item payloads may be discarded as evidence-scope changes only when the outer event is well-formed; unknown control events make usage-completeness unknown.
verification: Independent Go authored checks for exact comment-only tasks and catalog-min-context behavior in the pinned public candidate revision6b2c1bdfd38bea5a9a2c11433ffcfcb94c4143a3. Acceptance checks must fail on unchanged baseline and plausible incorrect changes. Verification evidence is separate from model identity/usage and tied to task spec/base/candidate hashes. Current test fixtures prove verifier behavior, not model performance.
validation: Test complete multi-turn, failed/error/incomplete, missing/null usage, duplicate/unknown controls, overflow, EOF/line/whole/event bounds, raw-content nonretention/redacted errors and immutable call ownership. Verifier tests need positive and negative behavior evidence, and unchanged baseline refusal. Full repository race/vet/format/secrets plus CI quality precede publication.
